title: Multi-dimensional OCCURS — WS-CELL(I, J) is one subscript, NOT two field paths
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MATRIX-MUL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-MATRIX.
           05  WS-ROW OCCURS 10 TIMES.
               10  WS-CELL OCCURS 10 TIMES   PIC 9(5).
      *> WS-CELL(I, J) references the (I,J) cell. The two subscripts
      *> are POSITIONAL (outer first). Reversing them silently reads
      *> from the wrong cell. Some legacy code writes them on
      *> separate lines (WS-ROW(I) WS-CELL(J)) which is invalid --
      *> the parser rejects that.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CELL(1, 1).
           STOP RUN.
notes: Multi-dim OCCURS is straightforward but the subscript order is easy to flip on port. Surface as a section-contract invariant pinning the (row, column) order.
